query.raw_text: Supply of 11 kV Grade Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated PVC Sheathed Armoured Aluminium Conductor Underground Power Cables for substation feeder extension. Conductor size 3 x 300 sq.mm, complying with latest national technical specifications and statutory Quality Control Orders.

technical_requirements.material_grade: Aluminium conductor (Grade H2/H4), XLPE compound insulation, extruded PVC inner sheath, galvanized steel strip armour, extruded PVC outer sheath
technical_requirements.voltage_rating: 11 kV (earthed system, 3.3 kV to 33 kV specification range)
technical_requirements.application_domain: Power Transmission and Distribution Substation Feeder
technical_requirements.operating_environment: Direct underground burial, tropical wet soil
technical_requirements.performance_parameters: Continuous conductor operating temperature 90°C, short circuit withstand 250°C, FRLS outer sheath
technical_requirements.installation_method: Direct underground trench burial and cable tray routing
technical_requirements.testing_requirements: Conductor resistance, insulation resistance, high voltage AC test, flammability test per IS 10810 (Part 53)
technical_requirements.packaging_marking: Continuous embossing of standard mark, manufacturer name, year of manufacture, voltage grade, and progressive sequential meter marking
scope_inclusions_required: Working voltage from 3.3 kV up to 33 kV

gold_standards.reason: Designated Indian Standard for crosslinked polyethylene insulated thermoplastic sheathed cables for working voltages from 3.3 kV up to and including 33 kV.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1.1: This standard (Part 2) covers the requirements of crosslinked polyethylene insulated and PVC sheathed cables for working voltages from 3.3 kV up to and including 33 kV.

allied_standards.reason: Normative testing standard prescribed in Clause 16.2 for verifying flammability and flame retardant properties of cable sheaths.
allied_standards.evidence_span: Clause 16.2: The flammability test shall be conducted in accordance with IS 10810 (Part 53).

allied_standards.reason: Prescribes specifications for conductors for insulated electric cables and flexible cords.
allied_standards.evidence_span: Clause 5.1: Conductor shall be of aluminium conforming to IS 8130.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Covers power cables up to 33 kV with identical voltage class and construction, but specifies PVC insulation instead of XLPE.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Tender explicitly specifies Crosslinked Polyethylene (XLPE) insulation. IS 1554 (Part 2) is restricted to PVC insulation and fails material compatibility.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Clause 1.1: This standard covers PVC insulated cables only.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Same product family (IS 7098 XLPE cables) and identical insulation material.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Part 1 covers cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V (1.1 kV). Tender requires 11 kV which is covered solely by Part 2.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Clause 1.1: This standard covers XLPE insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Cited prominently in cable specifications and shares testing keywords.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 10810 Part 53 is a test method standard (methods of test for cables), not a product specification standard.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Scope: Prescribes method for flammability test.

certification_requirement.qco_order_reference: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2023 issued by DPIIT
exemptions: Cables manufactured exclusively for overseas export under statutory customs bond.

expert_review.notes: Clear, unambiguous procurement query for 11 kV XLPE cable.

query.raw_text: Providing and fixing copper conductor, PVC insulated, unsheathed single core multi-strand cable conforming to IS 694 for internal domestic electrical point wiring in recessed heavy duty PVC conduit. Working voltage 1100 V, 2.5 sq.mm size, fire survival / low smoke halogen free.

technical_requirements.target_product: PVC Insulated Unsheathed Single Core Cable
technical_requirements.material_grade: Bare electrolytic copper multi-strand conductor, FR/FRLS grade PVC compound insulation
technical_requirements.voltage_rating: 1100 V (up to and including 1100 V AC)
technical_requirements.performance_parameters: FR/FRLS insulation grade, oxygen index >= 29%, temperature rating 70°C
technical_requirements.installation_method: Recessed heavy gauge PVC conduit in plaster/slab
technical_requirements.testing_requirements: Spark test, insulation resistance, flame retardance per IS 10810
technical_requirements.packaging_marking: 100-meter shrink-wrapped coils with ISI mark, license number, and batch details
scope_inclusions_required: PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to 1100 V
scope_exclusions_forbidden: Cables for working voltages exceeding 1100 V

gold_standards.reason: Primary Indian Standard specifying PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V for electric power and lighting.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1.1: This standard covers the requirements of PVC insulated single-core and multi-core cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V AC.

allied_standards.reason: Specifies requirements for electrolytic copper conductors used in building wiring cables.
allied_standards.evidence_span: Clause 6.1: Conductors shall be of copper conforming to IS 8130.

allied_standards.reason: Specifies conduits for electrical installations: Part 3 Rigid plain conduits of insulating materials.
allied_standards.evidence_span: Referenced for conduit compatibility in building wiring.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Also covers PVC insulated cables up to 1100 V, but is intended for heavy duty armoured/sheathed distribution rather than internal domestic point wiring.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 1554 Part 1 is meant for heavy duty industrial and distribution power/control cables, whereas building point wiring in conduits is exclusively governed by IS 694.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Foreword: IS 1554 covers heavy duty cables, whereas light duty wiring is under IS 694.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Covers insulated cables for low voltage, but specifically aerial bunched cables (ABC) for outdoor overhead distribution.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 14255 is an outdoor aerial bunched distribution cable, entirely incompatible with indoor conduit wiring.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Scope: Covers aerial bunched cables for overhead lines.

certification_requirement.qco_order_reference: Electrical Wires and Cables (Quality Control) Order, 2023

expert_review.notes: Semi-explicit query with explicit IS 694 reference.

source.organization: Department of AYUSH, Government of Gujarat

query.raw_text: Government Ayurvedic Dispensaries ke liye authentic Ashwagandha churna (Withania somnifera Dunal root powder) ki procurement. Root powder free from heavy metals, pesticide residues, microbial contamination, moisture content less than 8 percent, withanolide active content verified. Must meet Pharmacopoeial and Bureau of Indian Standards herbal specifications.

technical_requirements.target_product: Dried, pulverized roots of Withania somnifera (Linn.) Dunal
technical_requirements.material_grade: Withania somnifera (Linn.) Dunal root powder (Solanaceae family), minimum total withanolides content 0.3% w/w by HPLC
technical_requirements.application_domain: Ayurvedic Therapeutic Medication and Dispensary Dispensing
technical_requirements.operating_environment: Oral medicinal consumption, shelf storage under 30°C and 60% RH
technical_requirements.performance_parameters: Foreign matter <= 2%, total ash <= 7%, acid-insoluble ash <= 1%, alcohol soluble extractive >= 15%, water-soluble extractive >= 10%
technical_requirements.testing_requirements: Thin layer chromatography fingerprinting, HPLC assay for withanolide A and withaferin A, lead/arsenic/cadmium limits per API/BIS
technical_requirements.packaging_marking: Air-tight food-grade container with manufacturing date, expiry date, botanical name, and Ayurvedic batch license

gold_standards.reason: Indian Standard specifically covering Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera Dunal) roots specification and quality requirements.
gold_standards.evidence_span: Clause 1.1: This standard prescribes requirements and methods of test for dried roots of Withania somnifera (Linn.) Dunal.

allied_standards.reason: Provides standardized glossary of botanical and pharmacognostic terms for Ayurvedic raw materials.
allied_standards.evidence_span: Clause 3: Terms defined in IS 19084 shall apply.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Covers medicinal plant raw material in the same herbal standards series, but for Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus).
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 16429 is for Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus), a completely different botanical species and drug.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Clause 1.1 specifies Asparagus racemosus Willd. roots.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Covers herbal food supplement product, but from the Food & Agriculture division rather than pure botanical drug specification.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 19415 covers processed dietary health supplements, not pure pharmacopoeial root churna.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Scope covers processed health food preparations.

expert_review.notes: Hinglish query with botanical terms correctly resolved to IS 16424.

query.raw_text: Procurement of heavy duty 3-core flat submersible pump electrical cable for borehole dewatering pumps. Copper conductor, water resistant insulation.

technical_requirements.operating_environment: Continuous water immersion under hydrostatic pressure
technical_requirements.installation_method: Submerged inside deep borehole well casing

gold_standards.reason: Candidate pending clarification of voltage rating (IS 694 Part 2 / IS 9968 depending on PVC vs elastomer insulation).

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: Power cable standard, but not rated for continuous hydrostatic water immersion inside submersible borehole pumps.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: IS 7098 Part 2 is for underground power distribution, not submersible borehole pump applications.
hard_negatives.rejection_evidence_span: Clause 1.1 does not cover flexible submersible pump cables.

hard_negatives.confusability_reason: General PVC distribution cable, lacks specialized flexible flat submersible construction.
hard_negatives.rejection_reason: Fails application compatibility for continuous hydrostatic immersion.

expected_decision.expected_abstention_reason: Tender fails to specify working voltage rating (1.1 kV vs higher) and insulation compound (PVC per IS 694 Annex vs Rubber/Elastomer per IS 9968 Part 2), precluding unambiguous primary standard recommendation.

expert_review.notes: Safe abstention scenario: triggers INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION outcome.
